q: Which function is NEW in NIST CSF 2.0?
explain: CSF 2.0 (February 2024) added Govern, so it now has six functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover.

q: Testing data restores from backup belongs primarily to which NIST CSF function?
explain: Recover covers restoring systems and data after an incident. A backup that has never been tested is not evidence of recovery.

Essential cyber hygiene: the minimum set of safeguards for every organization
explain: IG1 is the starting point for everyone. IG2 and IG3 add safeguards for more complex organizations and those exposed to sophisticated attackers.

q: What is the difference between CIS Controls and CIS Benchmarks?
options: Controls are organizational controls (what to do), Benchmarks are detailed settings for a specific system (how to configure it)
Benchmarks is the old name for Controls
explain: E.g. CIS Control 4 requires secure configuration, and the CIS Benchmark for Ubuntu or Kubernetes provides hundreds of specific settings to satisfy it.

q: How many controls does Annex A of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 have?
explain: The 2022 version has 93 controls in four themes (37 organizational, 8 people, 14 physical, 34 technological). The 2013 version had 114 controls.

q: What is the Statement of Applicability (SoA) in ISO 27001?
options: A document that states for each Annex A control whether it applies and why
explain: The SoA is one of the key ISMS documents and the first one an auditor asks for.

q: A customer asks for evidence that your controls actually operated over the past year. Which report?
explain: Type I confirms the design of controls at a point in time. Type II tests their operating effectiveness over a period (usually 3 to 12 months).

q: Which SOC 2 Trust Services criterion is ALWAYS included?
explain: Security (Common Criteria) is mandatory. The other four are chosen based on the service and customer requirements.

q: Introducing Trivy scanning of Docker images in CI most directly supports which CIS control?
explain: Vulnerability scanning and remediation are the core of control 7. It also supports CIS 16 (Application Software Security).

q: Which EU regulation addresses the digital operational resilience of the financial sector and its ICT suppliers?
explain: DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) has applied since January 2025 and also covers critical ICT suppliers of financial institutions, including cloud providers.

q: Why do mature teams maintain one list of controls mapped to multiple frameworks?
options: One technical control and its evidence cover the requirements of several frameworks, so the work isn't done multiple times
explain: E.g. a central CloudTrail with protected logs simultaneously satisfies NIST DE, CIS 8, ISO A.8.15 and SOC 2 CC7. The evidence is collected once.
